edition.notes: Popular Hindi aarti 'Jai Shiv Omkara'. Collated against common temple booklets; minor line-order variants exist (as with all aartis). This is the widely sung eight-couplet form.

description.hi: सन्ध्या आरती — ब्रह्मा विष्णु सदाशिव अर्द्धाङ्गी धारा।
description.en: Evening aarti — Brahma, Vishnu, Sadashiva, the half-bodied Lord.
